name: catalogify
title_zh: 代码仓库的活体知识图谱，随 git 历史自动更新
tagline_zh: 读代码像翻书：服务、模块、API、数据模型全串成互链概念页，连 git 历史里的「为什么」都挖出来当注释。
tagline_en: Read code like a book: services, modules, APIs, data models linked into concept pages, with git history mined for.
desc_en: Generate and maintain an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) knowledge bundle for a source-code repository — a directory of cross-linked markdown concepts with YAML frontmatter describing its services, modules, APIs, data models, and operations. Use when asked to document a codebase as a knowledge base, build or refresh an OKF bundle or knowledge catalog, mine git history for the "why" behind code, k
why_zh: 不生成死目录，而是按 OKF v0.1 标准产出带 YAML 前置的交叉链接 Markdown。
why_en: Outputs OKF v0.1 bundles with YAML frontmatter and cross-links, not a flat file dump—so newcomers learn intent, not just.
limit_zh: 只认本地 Git 仓库且需已装 Python 3.9+；产物是 Markdown 概念页而非可运行文档站。
limit_en: Requires local Git repo & Python 3.9+. Emits Markdown concept pages only—no site rendering/deploy. Refuses non-OKF target dirs.
